text.en:
Section of Republic Act No. 10775 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"

June 21 of every year is hereby declared as special nonworking holiday in Tagaytay City, Province of Cavite in commemoration of its foundation day to be known as "Charter Day of Tagaytay City" or "Araw ng Lungsod ng Tagaytay".
Section 2 of Republic Act No. 10775 is hereby repealed.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
